statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
A 48-hour Holter monitor study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The monitoring is to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic events
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
This monitoring is clinically necessary to identify the cardiac cause of the patient's recurrent episodes
